text:
alex: Quick sync — who owns the remaining blockers for the pricing-change rollout? Need clarity on metering/billing/quotas/contracts before we flip flags. Ping owners.

priya: I can assemble an ownership rollup. High level: metering->Marco, billing->Jen (Finance), quotas->Omar (Backend), contracts->Li (Legal), infra->Marina (DevOps), marketing->Sasha. Can each confirm status?

marco: metering: webhook mapping for legacy customers still broken; adapter changes + tests in flight. PRs: https://github.com/redwood/metering/pull/432 and https://github.com/redwood/meters-adapter/pull/98. ETA EOW. Tests failing on rate-limit sim.

jen: finance: waiting on metering PR to finalise usage->invoice mapping. Also need negative-balance test vectors. I uploaded a draft to /shared/pricing/testvectors.csv. Target Tue for signoff.

omar: quotas: two choices affect UX and implementation — a) return 429 per-request pre-batch, or b) accept and let queue/batch drop later. We recommended (a) to avoid overspend. Need confirmation from Alex + Marco on placement of check.

li: contracts: small TOS clause change for tiered billing and reserved capacity. Legal review started; need final wording by Wed to include in contract riders.

marina: infra: capacity bump for dedicated test cluster scheduled Thu. Note: reserved capacity flags need to be toggled from product console; that requires a safe rollout window.

sasha: marketing: we want stable public tier names. Please avoid renaming tiers post-launch — we'll freeze names on Thu after legal signoff. :memo:

alex: Confirming quota check should be pre-batching to avoid overspend. Priya — can you produce a single checklist of PRs/tasks+owners? I'll collate if needed.

priya: Yep — I'll create a checklist in #eng-releases and post back here. ETA ~2h.

eng-bot: CI queued: metering tests (job 712) triggered by marco's PR — test matrix running.

marco: quick note — failing case is bursty requests from legacy SDK; fixing adapter logic now. I'll ping when PR green.

jen: finance test vectors uploaded: /shared/pricing/testvectors.csv — feedback welcome.

omar: question for the group: does quota enforcement run before or after batching? This changes where we check token counts. @alex @marco

alex: pre-batching — confirmed.

li: also confirm: are tier names published in public API/SDKs? We need to avoid legal conflicts with partner contracts.

sasha: yes public API surfaces tier identifier (stable). We'll coordinate freeze with product.

priya: Ownership summary for thread: marco (metering/PRs), jen (billing/test vectors), omar (quotas/behavior), li (contracts/legal wording), marina (infra/capacity), sasha (marketing/tier freeze). Next sync: Friday unless blockers crop up. If anyone has >1 day blocker, please DM me or Alex.

alex: :thumbsup: Thanks all. If anything blocks launch, escalate to me immediately. I'll follow up if anything moves to 'at risk'.
